text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Phew~... Alright, guess that's about it 
for today~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ayyy~, whatcha lookin' at? ...Hm, 'Healthy 
Living with Additive-Free Nuts'? Heh, look 
at you being so health-conscious.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh? Hell no. This is for my mom—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Your mom... for real!? Wait, what is it, a 
present!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, shut up, shut up! Don't make a big 
deal outta every little thing!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
She keeps sending care packages over and 
over even though I never asked for 'em... 
It feels gross just letting my debt to her 
keep piling up!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...So you're saying you wanna send 
something back in return, right? That's 
awesome. Getting presents for parents is 
super hard, though, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Saying 'thank you' feels kinda 
embarrassing and all. ...Yeah, you're 
seriously great. Pure top-tier filial 
piety samurai vibes.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Plus, looks like you're seriously picking 
it out, right~? Thinking about her health 
and all.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Mgh... What's wrong with that?! If Mom 
collapses from bad health again, it's just 
gonna be a massive pain!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Right, right, meaning you want her to stay 
healthy. Ah, then how 'bout... some health 
foods?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
My parents love that stuff and send it to 
me all the time, so... I might be able to 
spot the good stuff on sight!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Is this... Manuka honey? Is this stuff 
good...? Damn, there's a crazy number of 
varieties.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yup yup. And what was it called again... 
MGO? Apparently the higher that number is 
boosted, the more god-tier it gets.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
How's the MGO on the one here? Is it 
strong?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ummm... Ah, wait, I feel like the one my 
mom sent had way bigger numbers on it...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...?! Where do they sell that one!? If I'm 
picking one, it's gotta be the absolute 
strongest...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hold up! Lemme see, the shop Mom mentioned 
was... What, it's totally nearby!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
What?! Sold out...?! Tch, don't 
underestimate me! As if I'd give up over 
something like this!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Roger! Alright, let's raid a specialty 
honey store next!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No way~! They only stocked it until last 
month!? Seriously, even though the reviews 
mentioned it!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, then we just gotta find another 
place! I'll even head over to the next 
town if I have to!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...! Please, just give us a 
hit already~... Ah—!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Found it~~~! Espo-san, this, this one 
right here!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
O-Ohhh... OOOOOOH!! Hell yeah! You see 
that, dammit!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ayyy~! Total victory for us! Espo-san, 
gimme five~~~!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
N-No way in hell am I high-fiving you! 
Besides, why the hell are you looking so 
happy about it?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...? Why? Isn't that totally obvious?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, let's deco the present even more! 
Add ribbons and stuff!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ! ...H-Hmph! Fine by me, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I happened to run into familiar horse 
girls in town. Upon asking, it turned out 
they had just purchased a present for a 
mother together.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
You're way too soft, tagging along all the 
way to wrap the present and all.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's a present for a pal, right~? 
This kinda stuff gets me hype!

present

present

Maybe even more so because it's for her

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, really? This much feels pretty normal 
to me.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
See, whenever it's a friend's birthday 
present, you usually go shopping with your 
gang. That's just how it goes!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... Well, that's just like you, 
I guess.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah... who knows. Mom, huh~... hmm...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, that might actually be true. 
Like, watching Espo-san makes me kinda get 
it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe I should do something nice once 
in a while too~?
